meta.name: The Cage
meta.description: Dreaming of going pro, a young fighter struggles to be seen until an unexpected face-off lands him a shot at the big time — and a ruthless rivalry.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Just as he is about to give up on his dreams, a young MMA amateur makes unexpected waves when an enraged pro fighter bursts into his gym.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Taylor trains in Canada, Ibrahim comes under increasing pressure to accept his call out. Taylor's mother and her partner make a loaded request.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In desperate need of money, Taylor signs up for an intense KSW tournament in Poland, facing much heavier opponents and putting his career on the line.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ignoring the warning signs, Taylor prepares for the ultimate rematch against a pumped-up Ibrahim, while Niko rides high on his friend's newfound fame.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Desperate to avenge Boss, Taylor heads to Mexico to train but struggles to get back into the cage — until a fighting legend steps in to help.
